people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: He also hired one hundred thousand mighty men of valor out of Israel for one hundred talents of silver.
translations.bsb: He also hired 100,000 mighty men of valor from Israel for a hundred talents of silver.
